description: This file defines functions for parsing and validating session scope information related to QMD sessions, including scope allowance checks, scope derivation, and key normalization.

methods.name: isQmdScopeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given session scope is allowed based on the provided configuration and session key.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChannel
methods.description: Extracts the channel information from a session key.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChatType
methods.description: Extracts the chat type ('channel', 'group', 'direct') from a session key.

methods.name: parseQmdSessionScope
methods.description: Parses a session key into its scope components, including channel and chat type.

methods.name: normalizeQmdSessionKey
methods.description: Normalizes a session key by trimming, parsing, and converting to lowercase, excluding subagent keys.
